strategy.summary: Jubilee carries its bonus score from ball to ball. Hit the center Advance Value target to raise the displayed target and side-rollover value, use the side rollover buttons and rotating top-center rollover for their shown awards, and hit the target when Mystery Score is lit.

quickInfo.name: Holdover bonus
quickInfo.summary: The built bonus score carries from one ball to the next.

quickInfo.name: Advance Value
quickInfo.summary: Hit the center target to advance the value shown for the target and side rollovers.

quickInfo.name: Rotating score rollover
quickInfo.summary: The top-center rollover scores the value currently shown on its rotating display.

quickInfo.name: Mystery Score
quickInfo.summary: When Mystery Score is lit, the target awards that score instead of its ordinary displayed value.

quickInfo.name: On-off pop bumpers
quickInfo.summary: Each pop bumper scores its higher printed award only while its lamp is on.

steps.text: Hit the center Advance Value target to raise the displayed target and side-rollover value.
Roll over either side button to score the current side-rollover value.
Send the ball through the top-center rotating score rollover to collect the value it currently shows.
When Mystery Score is lit, hit the center target to collect the mystery award.
When a pop bumper's lamp is on, its playfield label shows the higher printed award.
